Overall the response conveys the core caution against premature linking, emphasizes comparison of resource/dimension overlap (JobQueue-level and compute-environment-level) before deciding, and notes shared environment doesn't imply shared incident. This substantively matches the expected output's intent, even if the framing (no live investigation) and phrasing differs.
